title: VFX particle sprite
description: One centred glow, flare, puff or debris shape on an opaque pure-black background, for additive-blend particle sprites.

guidance: Name one shape (for example soft glow, lens flare, smoke puff, ember, debris chunk) and its colour.
Centre the shape and leave dark margins on every side so it fades to black before the border.
Ask for an opaque pure-black (#000000) background and a bright subject that works with additive blending.
One shape only: no scene, no ground, no text, no characters.

prompt_rubric: The prompt names one clear shape and its colour.
The prompt asks for the shape centred, with dark margins on every side.
The prompt asks for an opaque pure-black (#000000) background and a bright subject that suits additive blending.
The prompt contains no text, logos, watermarks or real-world brands to render unless the purpose asks for them.
The prompt avoids contradictions (for example a transparent background and a pure-black background).
image_rubric: The image shows one centred shape, as the prompt asked, without extra subjects.
The shape keeps dark margins on every side and does not touch the border.
The background is pure black everywhere outside the shape; no grey haze, vignette or gradient.
The style matches the style preset; no mixed rendering styles.
No unwanted text, watermark, signature or frame.

constraints.background: Opaque pure black (#000000) background; the shape is bright and suits additive blending.
constraints.processing: Alpha extraction, channel packing and power-of-two resize are not asset-gen's job. The gen-run binds the output hashes and the image service ignores the requested size, so those transforms belong to the consuming package's import tool.
